N: Roots are still recovering; the basal dose covers this week.

Si: Silicon helps a little toward sturdy leaves.

Fe: Iron is usually enough except on high pH or dry soils.
Mn: Manganese is rarely short except on high pH soils.
Cu: Copper is needed only in traces; peat soils may run short.
Mo: Molybdenum is not a concern for this crop now.
Si: Silicon is not a concern at this stage.

insect: Insects can cut yield now if numbers build; scout weekly.
mite: Mites are minor now; watch in dry spells.
fungus: Fungal disease can spread now in wet weather.
bacteria: Bacterial disease risk is low now.
weed: Late weeds mostly add seed for next season.
snail: Plants are too tough for snails now.
rat: Rats do little harm now, but start community control early.
nematode: Nematodes do little harm now in most fields.

rice.N: Nitrogen after flowering is barely used; it feeds blast, sheath blight and hoppers and risks lodging.
rice.P: Phosphorus after panicle initiation comes too late to help the grain.
rice.K: Potassium after grain filling starts adds little; the straw already holds enough.
rice.Zn: Zinc after flowering only raises grain zinc, not yield.

corn_yellow.N: Nitrogen after early grain fill rarely pays; the ear draws on what the leaves hold.
corn_yellow.P: Phosphorus after silking comes too late to help the ear.
corn_yellow.K: Most potassium is taken up before tasselling; later doses add little.
corn_yellow.B: Boron after silking is too late for kernel set.

corn_sweet.N: Nitrogen near the milk stage is wasted and can lower ear quality.
corn_sweet.P: Phosphorus after silking comes too late to help the ear.
corn_sweet.B: Boron after silking is too late for kernel set.

sugarcane.N: Nitrogen after grand growth keeps cane growing and lowers sugar at harvest.
sugarcane.K: Potassium in the last months adds little to cane weight.

banana.N: Nitrogen near harvest only feeds the follower sucker, not the bunch.
banana.K: Potassium after the bunch is full comes too late for it.

leafy.N: Nitrogen near harvest raises leaf nitrate and makes heads loose and soft.

fruiting.N: Heavy nitrogen at flowering grows leaves instead of fruit and invites pests.
fruiting.Ca: Calcium given after blossom end rot shows cannot save the spoiled fruit.

cucurbit.N: Heavy nitrogen at flowering makes vines leafy and fruit set poor.

legume.N: Nitrogen after nodules form shuts down fixing and is mostly wasted.

root.N: Nitrogen after roots begin swelling grows tops at the cost of roots.

bulb.N: Nitrogen after bulbing starts gives thick necks and bulbs that rot in storage.

cereal.N: Nitrogen after flowering is barely used and invites lodging and disease.

tree.N: Nitrogen just before flowering pushes a leaf flush instead of flowers.
